notes.title: Update 1.28
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.28 is out:[/b]
Mostly bugfixes on the guns: some cosmetics where different on some systems. And worse, some actions could get stuck when a gun was fired and imediatly switched. Done.

Learnings: Always consider someone might press - All The Buttons - at once ;)
